commitment.title: Jeddah Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan
commitment.text: The Parties commit to... ensure the protection of civilians at all times, to allow and facilitate the rapid and unimpeded passage of humanitarian relief, and to refrain from any attack that may cause civilian casualties or damage to civilian objects.

sentences: Counts, not causes. Attribution is UCDP's, not ours.

Each fatality counted here is a person whose life ended in violence that a signed commitment promised would stop; we count the events because dignity itself cannot be scored, and the count is not the goal — the absence of the events is.
